svg.title: StillThere architecture
svg.desc: An MCP server on AWS for Alexa+. A family member asks through a simulated Echo Show. Route 53, CloudFront and API Gateway route the question to an assistant Lambda, which uses Amazon Bedrock to choose a tool on the MCP server Lambda. Separately, a scheduled assessment learns the resident's routine from DynamoDB and notifies the family through SNS when a usual habit does not happen. Ring device events arrive through a signed webhook.
svg.text: an Alexa+ MCP server on AWS that notices what didn't happen
AWS Cloud · us-east-1 · all in Terraform
runs on a timer, with nobody asking
secrets, keys, and the alarms on silence
Asking: a family member, or any MCP client
any MCP client · Bearer token · POST /mcp
nudge to the family, by SNS
